jobs.title: Developer Relations Manager
jobs.description: We're looking for a valiant Developer Relations Manager to join our pack and help us empower creators to build the best apps for the best AAA games around. As our DevRel maestro, you will work closely with the in-game app creators in our community - guiding them as they craft amazing app experiences across their favorite games, setting them up for success. So if you're a visionary with a knack for nurturing creative talent, have a deep love for gaming, and want to help us shape the future of the industry - step forth, come join our journey. ﻿ In this role, you will: Guide app developers towards creating successful apps, offering them support and strategic advice to lead them to greatness. Work with developers on improving user experience and product features, providing insightful app reviews to enhance app quality. Ensure developers have access to necessary resources by working closely with R&D, Marketing, QA, Support, Product, and Operations teams. Gain a deep understanding of developer business models, optimizing their collaboration with Overwolf and enhancing their success. Build and sustain strong relationships with app developer partners, fostering a collaborative and mutually beneficial environment. Take the helm in project execution, focusing on marketing strategies, growth, monetization, and long-term planning for sustained success. 2+ years in DevRel, Customer Success, or Account Management, with a focus on nurturing professional relationships Actively engaged in PC/Console gaming, showing a real passion for the gaming world Strong written and verbal English skills, able to communicate clearly and effectively Willingness to work flexible hours to sync with global time zones Independent and collaborative team player with strong interpersonal skills and a positive, proactive attitude Creative problem-solver, able to think on your feet and tackle complex challenges Skilled at multitasking, managing deadlines, and maintaining sharp attention to detail in a dynamic environment Experience with third-party developer platforms or managing gaming communities is a plus Vast experience in casting enchantment spells, throwing battle axes, and drinking Dwarven stout

jobs.title: Head of Data Engineering & Infrastructure
jobs.description: We’re on the hunt for a hands-on, highly technical Head of Data to evolve and scale Overwolf’s data foundation. As our Data Systems Maestro, you’ll own the systems that power decision-making across Overwolf – including our data warehouse, pipelines, platform, and the solutions behind internal teams and user-facing products. You’ll lead a talented data team while shaping a reliable, scalable ecosystem used by creators, mod authors, and millions of gamers worldwide. So if you thrive on turning complex data challenges into elegant solutions, love building high-performing teams, and want to help power the future of gaming and UGC – join our quest. In this role, you will: Engineer, maintain, and scale Overwolf’s core data warehouse, pipelines, and data platform. Design and manage reliable ETL and ELT flows across databases, APIs, event streams, business systems, and data lakes. Own data quality, event tracking, governance, and the company’s source-of-truth systems. Build data solutions for internal teams and external user-facing products used by creators, mod authors, and millions of gamers. Partner with business teams to transform data needs into robust self-serve analytics and AI-assisted insights. Lead and mentor data engineers, BI developers, and analysts while raising the technical bar across the data organization. Champion accessible data tooling and help foster a data-driven culture across the company. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field 7+ years of data engineering experience, preferably in a startup or fast-paced technology company 4+ years of management experience, preferably in B2B2C, marketplace, SaaS, or consumer-scale environments Proven experience building and leading technical data teams, including data engineers, BI developers, and analysts Strong hands-on experience designing and scaling cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake Deep expertise in SQL, data modeling, ETL and ELT pipelines, orchestration tools such as Airflow, and analytics-ready data models Experience owning data quality, governance, event tracking, and company-wide source-of-truth systems Strong understanding of SaaS metrics, marketplace dynamics, and user behavior analytics Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence technical and business stakeholders at all levels Bonus Points Passion for gaming, creators, and the creator economy Ability to tame wild data dragons, conquer pipeline dungeons, and keep dashboards flowing before your first cup of mana – or coffee, for that matter

jobs.title: Motion Graphics Designer
jobs.description: We’re on the hunt for a bold and creative Motion Graphics Designer to create compelling visual stories that bring our brands, products, and communities to life. As our Motion Design Spellcaster, you'll craft captivating videos, animations, and motion experiences that engage millions of gamers worldwide. From marketing campaigns and product explainers to landing pages and educational content, you'll help shape how players experience the Overwolf ecosystem. So if you're passionate about motion design, thrive on turning ideas into unforgettable visuals, and are ready to shape how millions of gamers experience our products – come join our quest. In this role, you will: Develop and produce exciting, creative motion designs from start to finish. Transform written concepts, scripts, and storyboards into captivating visual creations, whether through motion design, live video production, or other animated marketing materials. Collaborate with the design team to develop, refine, and implement our visual language, with a focus on instructional motion graphics design. Partner with the creative production team to create graphics and animations that enhance the educational quality of our courses and other materials. Collaborate with designers to incorporate motion graphics into websites and landing pages. 2+ years of experience in motion graphics design and video editing Demonstrable creative design skills with a strong portfolio Strong visual design skills and an eye for clean, simple design Proficiency with After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Figma, and a PC-based production environment Experience working in branding or advertising, preferably in a studio environment as part of a team Passion for hardcore gaming (PC and console) Bonus points: Experience with 3D modeling and animation Ability to animate vector icons and figures Experience capturing in-game footage or gameplay Familiarity with projects that begin with “yeah, this should be pretty simple.”

jobs.title: Product Design Lead
jobs.description: We’re on the hunt for a creative, systems-minded Product Designer Lead to join the Overwolf Apps Platform, the ecosystem that powers in-game creators and enhances gamer experiences. As our Design Architect of the Apps Realm, you’ll shape how millions of creators and gamers interact with Overwolf, from the Developer Console and documentation experience to the Overwolf Client and App Store. You’ll tackle complex, cross-product and platform-level design challenges, balancing strategy with hands-on craft, while collaborating closely with Product, R&D, and senior design leadership to deliver clarity, beauty, and impact. So if you live and breathe product thinking, thrive on simplifying complexity, and find joy in designing tools that empower gaming creators worldwide, this quest is totally yours. In this role, you will: Own the full design process, from concept to delivery, ensuring consistent, high-quality, and impactful user experiences Lead key design initiatives across Apps Platform products and help drive platform-level design strategy Collaborate closely with Product, R&D, stakeholders, and the Director of Product Design to define, shape, and execute the product vision Drive and initiate strategic thinking by participating in product vision, discovery, and planning sessions to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement Balance deep, long-term product design work with fast-paced concepting when needed Develop and evolve the Design System, maintaining quality and consistency across Overwolf’s products Mentor and guide other designers, sharing best practices and supporting design excellence across the team 6+ years of product design experience hands-on, with end-to-end ownership of complex projects and some leadership experience Experience designing for developer-facing or technical platforms, with the ability to simplify complex concepts into intuitive experiences Comfortable switching between deep product work and fast-paced concepting Strong grasp of UX/UI principles, information architecture, and design systems Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proactive, self-driven mindset and strong ownership of the product experience. A gamer at heart, with a strong understanding of the mindset, needs, and habits of our audience BA in Visual Communication or a related field ﻿Bonus Points Experience designing for gaming products or gamer-facing experiences Background in leading design initiatives or guiding other designers Thinks in grids, dreams in gradients, and balances everything but their caffeine levels

jobs.title: Publisher Operations Manager
jobs.description: We're on the hunt for a technically fluent Publisher Operations Manager to own the health and performance of the Overwolf Ads publisher portfolio. As our Yield Guardian, you'll monitor publisher activities end-to-end, run network-wide investigations, and work across Demand Ops and Publisher Success to turn performance gaps into solved problems. You'll use AI as a co-pilot and bring the judgment the tools can't: knowing what to look for, what it means, and what to do about it. So if you spot anomalies before the dashboard does, thrive untangling complex programmatic workflows, and genuinely want to improve the experience of every publisher in the portfolio - this quest is yours. Monitor and optimize the health of assigned publisher activity (bidder publishers or Nitro publishers) proactively, not reactively Run network-level optimization investigations, including success rate optimization, and own the implementation of findings Identify gaps in publisher or network performance and drive them to resolution end-to-end Serve as the operations point of contact for Demand Ops and Publisher Success on cross-functional publisher issues Use AI tooling to surface anomalies, identify patterns, and accelerate analysis Manage and optimize SSP and GAM configurations to improve publisher yield 1-3 years of experience in ad tech operations: publisher operations, programmatic operations, or yield management Hands-on experience with SSPs and Google Ad Manager (GAM) Technically fluent: you understand how ad systems and complex programmatic workflows connect, without being a developer Strong problem-solving instincts: move from symptom to root cause, not from symptom to escalation Passion for gaming and gaming culture Bonus Points: Experience with bidder management or direct publisher-side relationships Familiarity with analytics tooling and internal platform workflows

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager
jobs.description: We’re on the hunt for a fearless Senior Business Development Manager to spread the word about Overwolf’s innovative platform, champion UGC across the games industry, and build partnerships that drive meaningful business growth. As our Business Development Captain, you’ll develop a strong pipeline of strategic partners, bring Overwolf’s technology to more companies across the gaming ecosystem, and turn new opportunities into lasting relationships and business results. So if you’re passionate about gaming, energized by ambitious growth opportunities, and ready to build partnerships that can help shape the future of the industry, step forth and join our quest. This role is open to candidates residing anywhere in the US. Develop and execute strategic business and go-to-market plans that drive revenue growth and market expansion. Identify, onboard, and manage strategic partners and key accounts. Conduct market research and competitive analysis to uncover new business opportunities. Build strong relationships with clients and partners while delivering compelling presentations and product demos. Design, evaluate, and optimize sales campaigns and communication channels. Represent Overwolf at local conferences and events while supporting regional business needs. 6+ years of experience in the games industry. Strong interpersonal and networking skills, with a proven ability to generate new opportunities and build relationships with creators, gamers, developers, and game studios. Avid gamer who actively plays two to three core or hardcore titles. Strong mentoring and coaching skills, with a passion for sharing knowledge and helping others grow. High standards of professionalism and attention to detail, with the ability to represent Overwolf effectively in every interaction. Collaborative mindset, with the ability to respect team decisions and contribute constructively toward shared goals. Openness to feedback and a commitment to continuous learning and growth. Ability to travel internationally three to four times per year for conferences and industry events. Bonus Points Experience navigating complex negotiations and rogue coffee machines.

jobs.title: Web Designer
jobs.description: We’re on the hunt for a creative and versatile Web Designer to craft engaging digital experiences that bring our brands, products, and communities to life. As our Digital Design Maestro, you'll design websites, landing pages, and campaign experiences that showcase our products, support our creators, and engage millions of gamers worldwide. From product launches and special activations to brand campaigns and community initiatives, you'll help shape how players interact with the Overwolf ecosystem. So if you're passionate about web design, thrive on turning ideas into engaging digital experiences, and are ready to shape how millions of gamers interact with our products – come join our quest. In this role, you will: Conceptualize and produce exciting creative concepts in the realm of AAA gaming from start to finish. Create user experiences and static or animated assets, including websites, landing pages, banners, and motion graphics elements. Compose narratives, scripts, storyboards, and visual adaptations for your concepts, whether through live video production, motion design, web design, or other marketing materials. Help talented creators promote their apps and mods to millions of gamers and empower them to make a living from the projects they’re passionate about. Collaborate with the team to create fully realized marketing campaigns across our various products. 2+ years of proven web design experience across web apps, websites, and advertising Demonstrable creative design skills with a strong portfolio Strong visual design skills and an eye for clean, simple design Solid experience creating wireframes and storyboards from briefs Proficiency with Figma, Photoshop, and After Effects in a PC-based production environment Experience leveraging AI-powered tools to enhance creative workflows when appropriate Passion for hardcore gaming (PC and console) Bonus points: Experience with 3D modeling and animation Proficiency with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for prototyping purposes Ability to illustrate vector icons and figures Ability to illustrate 2D art, characters, and concepts Experience capturing in-game footage or gameplay Natural resistance to scope creep, deadline dragons, and rogue content requests
